Source: blueprint order 1505 (blueprint: def-coefficient-twists-detailed). Proof: at zero take the completed coefficient inclusion. At one send the root limit tensor b to the same root limit tensor its integer image. The balanced relations agree by the finite residue characterizations of the completed actions. For positive powers tensor these maps recursively. For negative powers use the unique dual map whose evaluation is the image of the original evaluation. On a cover trivializing the root line these maps are the coefficient inclusion, so the positive maps generate the target line and the dual map is unique. The formulas commute with restrictions and glue; tensor sheafification and the local generation of each positive line prove uniqueness in every degree.
